# Samphire Neuroscience

> Brain-based wearable solutions for women's hormonal health, menstrual cycle support, and mood regulation.

Samphire Neuroscience develops neuroscience-backed wearables and apps designed to support women's health across their menstrual cycle. The platform combines brain-based wellness technology with cycle tracking to address conditions like PMDD, PMS, endometriosis, and dysmenorrhea while promoting overall hormonal wellbeing.

## Core Products

- [Lutea Wearable](https://www.samphireneuro.com/en-gb/products/lutea): Brain-based wearable for hormonal wellbeing, stress reduction, and daily cycle support.
- [Nettle Wearable](https://www.samphireneuro.com/en-gb/products/nettle): Brain-based wearable for menstrual pain relief and mood support across your cycle.
- [Samphire App](https://www.samphireneuro.com/en-gb/products/app): Brain-first menstrual health app with integrated cycle tracking and wellness features.

## Menstrual Health Conditions

- [PMDD Support](https://www.samphireneuro.com/pmdd): Ease PMDD symptoms with Samphire's brain-based wearable tools and neuroscience approach.
- [PMS Relief](https://www.samphireneuro.com/pms): PMS symptom relief solutions using Nettle wearable and brain-based wellness support.
- [Dysmenorrhea Pain Relief](https://www.samphireneuro.com/dysmenorrhea): Menstrual pain management through Nettle wearable and brain-body connection techniques.
- [Endometriosis Support](https://www.samphireneuro.com/endometriosis): Endometriosis symptom management using Nettle and Samphire App solutions.

## Wellness & Brain Health

- [Mood & Emotions](https://www.samphireneuro.com/emotions): Stabilize mood swings and regulate emotions with Samphire's brain-based wearables.
- [Stress & Anxiety Management](https://www.samphireneuro.com/stress): Stress and anxiety management across your menstrual cycle with Samphire tools.
- [Sleep Improvement](https://www.samphireneuro.com/sleep): Enhance sleep quality and rest through nervous system support with Samphire wearables.
- [Neuroplasticity & Brain Health](https://www.samphireneuro.com/neuroplasticity): Enhance brain health and neuroplasticity with Samphire's brain-based wearable tools.
- [ADHD & Menstrual Cycle](https://www.samphireneuro.com/adhd): Support ADHD symptoms and menstrual cycle health through brain-based Samphire solutions.
